THE roads and lanes which are deem to be owned by Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha in which are relevant notiﬁ cation is included published in the Gazette No. 2408/10 dated 29th of October, 2024 under the terms made by Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987, as the “orders on the preparation of plans and posting of notices showing the list of names of the roads and lanes” maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha of Sabaragamuwa Province as the Honorable Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province has published in the Special Gazette No. 2316/20 and dated 24th of January, 2023 and it is hereby published for the public that it has been decided under decision No. 01 of 11 February, 2025 that all said road and lanes shall be owned by Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha as because of any case has not been assigned in a competent count on the date ﬁ xed by the said notiﬁ cation.

It is further announced that all roads and lanes included therein shall be deemed to be roads and lanes established by the Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub-section (5) of Section 24 of Pradeshiya Sabha act list of those road and lanes is included in the schedule here.
K. V. P. Iඋൺඇ඀ൺඇං, Secretary and Implementation Oﬃ cer of Powers, Functions and Duties, Kolonna Pradeshiya Sabha.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
